dogecoin.text: @mira_hurley @elonmusk @heydave7 @dogecoin_devs I agree in principle. In this case, I would like to see people adopting a solution for what you described, and not because Elon said so. The NANO community is good, and I am not sure having the Elon army joining would do it any good, but what do I know.

@mira_hurley @elonmusk @heydave7 @dogecoin_devs I commend you for your dedication. While we are part of different communities, I think, ultimately, we are on the same side. We want what's best for the world it's not Bitcoin nor Doge... But this is borderline cringe - "unleash your meme army on us", is it what you want?
